class.name: EditorExportPlatformWindowsNT4
class.brief_description: Editor export platform targeting Windows NT 4.0.
class.description: Describes export settings for Windows NT 4.0. Uses NT4-compatible x86_32 MinGW templates, which also run on newer Windows. The export adds the [code]windows[/code] and [code]win_nt4[/code] feature tags.

members.member: Company name shown in the executable's version details.
Copyright notice shown in the executable's version details.
File description shown in Windows Explorer.
File version of the executable. Falls back to [member ProjectSettings.application/config/version] when left empty.

Icon for the exported executable. When empty, uses [member ProjectSettings.application/config/windows_native_icon], then [member ProjectSettings.application/config/icon]. PNG-compressed ICO frames are converted to bitmap frames for legacy Windows.
If [code]true[/code], applies the icon and version details to the main executable during export. Requires the editor to be running on Windows. Defaults to [code]false[/code].
Product name shown in the executable's version details.
Product version of the executable. Falls back to [member ProjectSettings.application/config/version] when left empty.
Trademark notice shown in the executable's version details.
The CPU architecture of the exported executable. Only [code]x86_32[/code] is supported.
If [code]true[/code], embeds the project's PCK file in the exported executable instead of creating a separate [code].pck[/code] file.
Path to a custom debug export template. If empty, the platform's default debug template is used.
Path to a custom release export template. If empty, the platform's default release template is used.

Controls when a console wrapper executable is exported alongside the main executable, allowing the project to run with console output. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable, [code]1[/code] for debug exports only, or [code]2[/code] for both debug and release exports.

Controls when a separate debug symbols file is exported alongside the executable. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable, [code]1[/code] for debug exports only, or [code]2[/code] for both debug and release exports. Requires a matching [code].debugsymbols[/code] file or [code].debugsymbols.zip[/code] archive beside the export template.
If [code]true[/code], compiles shaders during export and embeds them in the exported project. Requires the Forward+ or Mobile renderer and is ignored for dedicated server exports.
If [code]true[/code], includes ETC2/ASTC-compressed textures in the exported project.
If [code]true[/code], includes S3TC/BPTC-compressed textures in the exported project.
